questions.text: Did the Meridian Community Bank pilot launch in September 2026 as planned? If it did, give the launch date, how many restaurants have been onboarded through the bank channel so far, and the MRR attributable to them. If it did not, what is the current status of the LOI and the revised launch date?
questions.why: In Q2 the company reported a signed Meridian pilot LOI with a September 2026 launch. The bank channel is the core of our distribution thesis, so we need to know whether the commitment was met.

questions.text: For the 9 mid-market restaurant groups in the Q2 pipeline, how many have signed, how many are still active, and how many have dropped out? For any signed deals, what are the location count and contracted MRR?
questions.why: The Q2 update cited 9 restaurant groups in the mid-market pipeline. The company should now be able to report the outcome of each.

questions.text: Of the six roles planned to open in H2 2026, which have been filled, which are still in process, and which have been deferred or cancelled? For the unfilled roles, what are the expected start dates?
questions.why: The six H2 roles were the main driver of planned burn growth behind the ~22-month runway reported in Q2. The standard headcount question covers only quarter-end hires and departures, not the status of the remaining roles.
